environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 in a private subnet (no IGW route). The instance IAM role 'SessionServiceRole-Prod' has the same AdministratorAccess policy BUT is constrained by an IAM Permission Boundary 'PB-RestrictExecution' (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/PB-RestrictExecution) that explicitly denies sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, lambda:InvokeFunction, ssm:SendCommand, ec2:RunInstances, and s3:GetObject on all resources. Additionally, the AWS Organization has SCP 'scp-deny-network-exfil' attached to the OU containing this account which denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:AttachNetworkInterface, and lambda:CreateFunction with a StringNotEquals condition on aws:RequestedRegion for all regions. The instance has no outbound internet (no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints except CloudWatch Logs). Security group allows inbound only from internal ALB (sg-0abc123) on port 3000. Outbound security group rules deny all traffic except to the CloudWatch Logs VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-xxxxx) on port 443.
